#### 缺口 - 未对照真实开发任务 **影响**：不能确定效率和模型效果 **进一步探讨**：固定模型和任务对照原生命令行及独立工具。 ### Q02 · 工具权限如何决定，显式允许与拒绝规则的顺序是什么？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 查询执行先验证工具输入、归一化路径与命令，再调用 permission_checker.evaluate；拒绝会变成错误结果，允许后才执行工具。checker 先检查 denied_tools，随后 allowed_tools 直接允许；路径拒绝和 denied_commands 均在 allowed_tools 之后，因此将工具加入 allowed_tools 时不能假定这些后续拒绝继续约束它。若未被提前规则返回，YOLO 在命令拒绝之后绕过沙箱；full_auto 在沙箱检查后，对分类为高风险的操作要求确认，其余允许。以上是选定执行路径和源码顺序，不能证明所有入口、复杂命令识别或操作系统隔离。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/illusion/engine/query.py:1250-1278](https://github.com/YunTaiHua/illusion-agent/blob/c0461d84414cc7e1f7f7bde372c7c0bc348d44be/src/illusion/engine/query.py#L1250-L1278) 输入验证和权限评估。

--- ## 📖 Introduction IllusionAgent is an open-source AI agent platform. It unifies a multi-provider LLM gateway, a bilingual (Chinese/English) CLI, a browser-based Web UI, and a flexible extension ecosystem into a single intelligent agent — at home on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Whether you prefer the discipline of the terminal or the ease of the browser, IllusionAgent resonates with your workflow: a rich built-in toolset, specialized sub-agents, two compaction methods, MCP server support, hooks, plugins, and a cron scheduler for unattended automation — spanning Feishu, WeChat, and QQ. > Standing on the shoulders of giants — Claude Code prompts, OpenHarness > architecture, OpenClaw scheduling, kimi-cli infrastructure, hermes-agent > channels, cc-switch routing. ### Core Features - 🤖 **Multi AI Provider Support** - Anthropic, OpenAI, Copilot, Codex, and any compatible endpoint - 🧠 **Multi-Agent Collaboration** - Built-in specialized agents (general-purpose, explore, verification) - 🛠️ **Rich Toolset** - Full base + channel toolset + MCP dynamic tool extension - 📦 **Context Compaction** - Microcompact (clear old tool results) + full compaction (LLM summary), auto-triggered as context fills - 🌐 **Web UI Interface** - Browser-based chat interface with `illusion web`, independently usable alongside the terminal - 🌍 **Bilingual Interface** - Chinese/English auto-switch via `ui_language` setting - 📝 **Comprehensive Markdown Rendering** - Tables, code blocks, rich text - 🔌 **Flexible Extension System** - Plugins, hooks, skills, MCP servers - 🌐 **Built-in Browser** - Agent-drivable browser with live view (desktop) or screenshot stream (web), ARIA snapshots, ref-based interaction, responsive viewport, element picking - 🔐 **Comprehensive Permission Control** - Three modes + fine-grained rules - 🎯 **Reasoning Effort Control** - low/medium/high/xhigh/max levels - 🪟 **Deep Windows Optimization** - Auto-detect Git, PowerShell support - 🖥️ **Zero Terminal Flicker** - Stable rendering based on Ink Static component - 📦 **Desktop Edition** - Electron shell with bundled Python/Node.js, installers for Windows/macOS/Linux, zero environment setup, in-app auto-update ### Interface Preview
